ai_review.summary: Hot, high‑energy show with smoking Jerry solos on “Fire” and “They Love Each Other”, captured in a solid (though unspecified) recording.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, highlighting an especially fiery guitar climax on "Fire on the Mountain" and a creative, out‑of‑the‑ordinary solo during "They Love Each Other." No technical complaints were made, suggesting the recording is at least clear enough to enjoy the band’s hot playing throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments about musical performance (both 4‑5 stars) and no noted recording problems; limited to two detailed reviews, so confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not mention any audio flaws, implying the sound is acceptable and listenable despite no specific source details.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently high‑energy performance throughout; reviewers note the band was rippin' during this tour.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Exceptional solo on "Fire" (dog‑tail chase vibe) and a creative, smoking solo in "They Love Each Other."
